title: The Intraday Gamma-Variance Channel with Public Options Data
one_line: Tests whether dealer gamma estimated from PUBLIC options data predicts intraday S&P realized variance (the gamma-variance channel); a 2026 Princeton thesis on the same question finds the hedging-feedback channel adds little forecasting power beyond standard volatility models.

findings.statement: Gamma estimated from public open interest is linked to intraday variance; size of incremental power disputed.
